# Vendored scripts

Served locally so the studio works without internet access.

- `elk.bundled.js`: [elkjs](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs) 0.9.3 (`lib/elk.bundled.js` of the npm package),
  the Eclipse Layout Kernel compiled to JavaScript; it lays out the map of the Jointures tab.
